audience.text: Rust developers building applications that require reading, writing, and manipulating Excel .xlsx files without relying on Microsoft Office or Aspose.Cells Enterprise Edition.

capabilities.text: Load and save Excel .xlsx files from paths, streams, or in-memory bytes with optional repair of corrupted packages and structured diagnostics reporting.
capabilities.title: XLSX file I/O with repair support

capabilities.text: Read and write typed cell values including strings, numbers, booleans, dates, and formulas with cached results through Cell and CellMut interfaces.
capabilities.title: Cell value management

capabilities.text: Apply comprehensive cell styling including fonts, fills, borders, alignment, number formats, and text wrapping through CellStyle and StyleFlag APIs.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Manage worksheets including adding, renaming, hiding, reordering, and protecting sheets with freeze panes, page setup, and visibility controls.
capabilities.title: Worksheet organization

capabilities.text: Enforce data validation rules and apply conditional formatting including color scales, data bars, icon sets, and formula-based rules.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Create charts with multiple types, embed pictures, add drawing shapes, and generate sparkline trend charts within worksheets.
capabilities.title: Charts, shapes, and sparklines

capabilities.text: Build Excel tables with ListObject including totals and table styles, and configure auto-filters with complex sorting and filtering conditions.
capabilities.title: Structured tables and filters

capabilities.text: Read and write core and extended document properties, manage workbook and worksheet protection with password hashing and encryption settings.
capabilities.title: Document properties and protection

limitations.text: Supports only .xlsx format; no legacy .xls, ODS, or CSV file format handling is implemented.
A workbook must always contain at least one worksheet; removing the last worksheet returns an Unsupported error.
The public API surface is broad but not a complete match for Aspose.Cells Enterprise Edition; some features remain partial or incomplete.
No automated test suite ships yet; correctness is verified through samples that perform round-trip load-save-load operations.
Not yet published to crates.io; installation requires Git dependency or local path dependency configuration.
The library is early-stage and evolving; API stability and feature completeness may change between versions.

problems_solved.text: Enables pure-Rust Excel file processing without requiring Microsoft Office installation or proprietary Aspose runtime dependencies.
Provides a familiar object model (Workbook/Worksheet/Cells) for developers experienced with Aspose.Cells while maintaining a fully open-source implementation.
Supports robust loading of potentially corrupted XLSX files through repair options and structured diagnostics reporting.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust is a pure-Rust library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without external dependencies or proprietary runtimes.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported chart types beyond those explicitly named in public symbols is unclear.
Whether all AutoFilter features including dynamic filters, top 10 filters, and custom filters are fully implemented is not fully evident from the symbol list alone.
The completeness of formula calculation support beyond caching is not specified in the available facts.
Whether all page setup options including headers/footers with complex formatting are fully supported is uncertain.
The extent of support for advanced validation types beyond basic list and date validation is unclear.
Whether sparkline styling options beyond basic type and range configuration are fully exposed is uncertain.
The behavior of protection features when using different hash algorithms or password lengths is not detailed.
Whether document properties beyond core and extended sets are supported is not specified.

workflows.name: Load and save XLSX files
workflows.text: Load an XLSX file from path, stream, or bytes using Workbook::load_xlsx variants, then save back to file, stream, or bytes using Workbook::save_xlsx variants.

workflows.name: Edit cell values and formulas
workflows.text: Access cells via Cells::get or Cells::get_by_index, write typed values using CellMut::put_value_* methods, and set formulas with cached results using CellMut::put_formula_with_cached_value.

workflows.name: Apply cell styling
workflows.text: Modify cell appearance using CellMut::apply_* methods for common styles or CellMut::set_style with CellStyle containing Font, Fill, and Borders configurations.

workflows.name: Configure worksheet layout and protection
workflows.text: Manage worksheet visibility, tab color, gridlines, zoom, and protection state through Worksheet properties and methods like set_visibility_type, set_tab_color, and protect/unprotect.

workflows.name: Build charts and sparklines
workflows.text: Create charts using ChartCollection::add with specified ChartType and data range, and add sparkline groups using SparklineGroupCollection::add with location and data ranges.

workflows.name: Enforce data validation and conditional formatting
workflows.text: Add validation rules using ValidationCollection::add with ValidationType and operator settings, and apply conditional formatting via ConditionalFormattingCollection::add_condition_with_details.
